content_markdown:
*At its best, the [#MeToo](https://metoomvmt.org/) movement sparked a powerful cultural awakening, exposing patterns of sexual abuse that had long been covered up—particularly in the entertainment industry. Yet despite its important impact, #MeToo stopped short of confronting the most egregious forms of sexual abuse at the highest levels of power.*

*At [WantToKnow.info](https://www.wanttoknow.info/),we are dedicated to shining a light into the darkest corners of the world, bringing us together in service to the greater good and collective transformation on this planet. We've [archived](https://www.wanttoknow.info/db-public/artwtk?aq=&cat=49) over 800 stories of verifiable sexual abuse scandals—exposing cover-ups in the Catholic Church, government agencies, [the medical establishment](https://www.wanttoknow.info/db-public/artwtk?aq=&cat=68), the military-industrial complex, Hollywood’s pedophilia networks, and beyond. We’ve also created a dedicated [news category archive](https://www.wanttoknow.info/db-public/artwtk?aq=&cat=71) on Jeffrey Epstein's child sex trafficking ring, where hundreds of underage girls were trafficked to the rich and powerful for decades. When undeniable evidence of Epstein’s child sex trafficking ring was brought to light in court in 2008, the whole system shielded him and his associates from the gravity of his crimes.*

***Below, we present the best of our research connecting Epstein's sex trafficking network to a long history of sexual blackmail operations involving the highest levels of power.***

---

Starting from the late 70s, wealthy lobbyist and socialite Craig Spence [ran a sexual blackmail operation](https://www.wanttoknow.info/890629washingtontimesfranklin) in D.C. involving underage boys where "call boys" would go on "midnight tours" of the White House. According to obtained credit card records, clients included key officials of the Reagan and Bush administrations, US military officers, businessmen, lawyers, bankers, congressional aides, and media stars.

Many of these parties also took place at Spence’s house, which was bugged and had secret two-way mirrors used to spy on guests. [According to Spence's body guards and various associates](https://www.futile.work/uploads/1/5/0/1/15012114/power-broker-served-drugs.pdf), Spence provided cocaine and secretly filmed people in compromising sexual encounters with the intent of extortion and blackmail.

When the ring was exposed, [Spence died under mysterious circumstances](https://www.futile.work/uploads/1/5/0/1/15012114/spence-stayed-true-to-form.pdf). Similar to [Epstein’s death](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-internal-prison-files-suggest-epstein-suicide-coverup), Spence’s death was quickly ruled as a suicide.

Shortly before his death, Spence told associates and reporters that [he worked for the CIA](https://www.futile.work/uploads/1/5/0/1/15012114/spence-stayed-true-to-form.pdf), and that the call-boy operation was being investigated by federal authorities as a possible CIA front. **Spence admitted that the CIA was using the service to compromise federal intelligence officials and foreign diplomats. He told them that "his life was over" now that the sex ring was exposed, and that "Casey’s boys are out to get me," referring to then-CIA director William Casey.**

According to Boston detectives handling the investigation, next to Spence’s deceased body was a newspaper clipping detailing efforts to initiate legislation that would give protection to CIA agents called upon to testify before the government.

> *What you have to understand, John [DeCamp], is that sometimes there are forces and events too big, too powerful, with so much at stake for other people or institutions, that you cannot do anything about them, not matter how evil or wrong they are and no matter how dedicated or sincere you are or how much evidence you have. That is simply one of the hard facts of life you have to face. You have done your part. You have tried to expose the evil and wrongdoing. It has hurt you terribly. But it has not killed you up to this point. I am telling you, get out of this before it does. Sometimes things are just too big for us to deal with, and we have to step aside and let history take its course. For you, John, this is one of those times.* – Former CIA Director William Colby, *[The Franklin Cover-Up](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mk/franklin-cover-up.pdf)*

After serving as a Nebraska State Senator, lawyer, and decorated Vietnam War veteran, John DeCamp dedicated himself to investigating the [Franklin Scandal](https://www.wanttoknow.info/060501conspiracyofsilence). His book *[The Franklin Cover-Up](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mk/franklin-cover-up.pdf)* investigates the 1988 shutdown of Omaha's Franklin Community Federal Credit Union, where $40 million was discovered missing under the management of multi-millionaire businessman and [former chair](https://www.reaganlibrary.gov/public/2023-10/40-819-198416-K-LawrenceKingJr-002-2023.pdf) of the Nebraska Black Republican Council [Lawrence E. "Larry" King](https://www.c-span.org/clip/public-affairs-event/user-clip-lawrence-king-sings-the-national-anthem/4781767).

This financial scandal became part of a much larger conspiracy that involved a nationwide child abuse ring, pornography, drug trafficking, and credible allegations of ritual murder. The Franklin scandal was a series of official investigations involving the Nebraska State Legislature, state and federal grand juries, disturbing court testimonies, and sealed records. It was discovered that many of the children involved [came from the foster care system](https://www.nytimes.com/1988/12/25/us/nebraska-inquiry-is-given-file-on-sex-abuse-of-foster-children.html), and were flown across US and sexually abused by officials and elites at the highest levels of power. In his book, DeCamp discovered a network of CIA sexual blackmail operations, some of which connected the Franklin Scandal to Spence's blackmail ring through credit card records.

**[More than a dozen people](https://wikispooks.com/wiki/Document:The_Franklin_Cover-up#Suspicious_Deaths_Tied_to_the_Franklin_Cover-Up) investigating the Franklin case died under mysterious circumstances**. State and federal grand juries concluded that the allegations were unfounded, labeling them a "carefully crafted hoax." Alleged victims who came forward with their stories of abuse were not only dismissed but sentenced to 9-15 years in prison for perjury.

If the allegations were baseless, why did a civil court find Larry King liable and award Paul Bonacci [$1 million in damages](https://archive.org/details/97302292-paul-bonacci-court-transcripts-from-larry-king-lawsuit/page/n1/mode/2up?view=theater) due to the sustained abuse and psychological trauma he endured involving organized child abuse, sex trafficking, and satanic rituals?

Below, DeCamp recalls his interaction with Judge Enbody, a Nebraska Supreme Court appointee for these hearings. DeCamp later learned that Judge Embody had just been appointed to the Court of Appeals, a very substantial advancement in his career that likely ensured the case was handled in a way that protected certain individuals.

> "*I do not understand it, Your Honor," I kept repeating. "As God is my witness, I do not think that there is a judge or other person involved in this case who does not know that horrible injustice has been done. **Your Honor, a person has to be deaf, dumb, blind, and totally dishonest, not to know that some of this state's and nation's top businessmen and public officials have engaged in the worst crimes possible, which are now being covered up. And these kids, instead of being honored and protected for exposing these things, are being sent to prison.** Why? Why? Why?"*
>
> *Judge Enbody looked at me. Slowly, his voice shaking, he began to talk. "I am just a man. I am not a god. I wish I were. I have no choice in what I have done. I am just a man, just a man, not a god," Judge Enbody concluded. He appeared even more shaken and upset than I was.*
>
> *What they all have done, and will continue to do: **Protect the "system" at all costs.** The "system" is the only ultimate sacred cow-not any particular law or constitution, but only "the system." Because, ultimately, it is the system which makes certain that the individuals functioning within it-from judges to lawyers, to prosecutors, to politicians, to businessmenhave their places and positions, and opportunities and pecking order, and future."*

### **And Then Comes Jeffrey Epstein**

Jeffrey Epstein was a shadowy billionaire who [trafficked hundreds of young women and minors for the rich and powerful](https://www.wanttoknow.info/jeffrey-epsteinnewsstories) — from politicians, royal family members, celebrities, former presidents and world leaders, scientists, business tycoons, and other power elites. [According to Epstein’s close associates](https://www.salon.com/2019/07/09/i-was-a-friend-of-jeffrey-epstein-heres-what-i-know/), Epstein managed money for clients with mega-fortunes and claimed to be a "high-level bounty hunter" for governments and wealthy clients around the world. For decades, dozens of girls as young as middle school age were lured, groomed, and paid in cash for sex with Epstein and his clients. These girls were instructed to recruit other vulnerable girls, many of them at-risk and/or homeless.

> *Epstein’s ties to the rich and the powerful seems to have allowed him to continue to rape and sex traffic teenagers. Transcripts show that the grand jury heard testimony that Epstein, who was then in his 40s, had raped teenage girls as young as 14 at his Palm Beach mansion. [A] teenager ... told detectives that she was 17 years old when she was approached by a friend who said she could make $200 by providing a massage at Epstein’s home. Epstein told her that he would pay her if she brought other “girls” to his home. **“And he told her, ‘The younger, the better,’”** [Palm Beach Police Det. Joe] Recarey said.*
> —"[Florida prosecutors knew Epstein raped teenage girls 2 years before cutting deal](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-florida-prosecutors-knew-epstein-raped-teenage-girls-2-years-before-cutting-deal-transcript-shows)," CNN

When undeniable evidence of Epstein’s child sex trafficking ring was brought to light in court in 2008, the whole system shielded him and his associates from the gravity of his crimes. **What would’ve been a federal indictment for life in prison turned into one of the most lenient deals for a serial child sex offender in history, landing him only 13 months in county jail. Most shockingly, his sentence would shut down an ongoing FBI probe** into whether there were more victims and other powerful people who took part in Epstein’s sex crimes.

The person who signed off on this "sweetheart deal" for Epstein was Miami’s top federal prosecutor, Alexander Acosta. It was revealed that he was told "**[Epstein belonged to intelligence, and to leave it alone](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-jeffrey-epstein-ran-sex-blackmail-operation-intelligence-agencies-new-evidence-suggests).**" Years later, Acosta would become the US Secretary of Labor from 2017-2019, whose purview included combating human trafficking.

After Epstein's conviction in 2008, Epstein [continued his sex trafficking operations](https://www.wsj.com/us-news/jeffrey-epstein-sexual-abuse-women-vip-connections-f5451078) until his arrest in 2019.

Major news outlets, including ABC News, [suppressed key evidence](https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2019/11/05/ive-had-this-story-three-years-abc-news-anchor-slams-her-networks-handling-epstein-scoop/) in the Epstein case, with journalist Amy Robach admitting her network "quashed the story" after pressure from the British royal family and powerful figures like Alan Dershowitz. Epstein used legal threats, intimidation, and even a [$30,000 donation](https://www.npr.org/2019/08/22/753390385/a-dead-cat-a-lawyers-call-and-a-5-figure-donation-how-media-fell-short-on-epstei) to a *New York Times* reporter’s nonprofit to influence coverage.

**What could possibly be behind such powerful government protection of a convicted sex offender?** After he became a convicted sex offender, why was Epstein [meeting with high-level officials](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-jeffrey-epstein-ran-sex-blackmail-operation-intelligence-agencies-new-evidence-suggests) including CIA director William Burns and former White House counsel under President Barack Obama? Could it be that Epstein was running a sexual blackmail operation similar to Spence's?

According to [court papers](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--sex-slave-scandal-exposed-pedophile-billionaire-jeffrey-epstein), "Epstein wired his mansion with [hidden cameras](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-jeffrey-epstein-accuser-says-his-house-had-cameras-monitoring-private-moments), secretly recording orgies involving his prominent friends and underage girls. The ultimate purpose: blackmail." Former Israeli spy Ari Ben-Menashe alleged that Epstein was running a [sexual blackmail operation](https://www.mintpressnews.com/ari-ben-menashe-israel-relationship-jeffrey-epstein/263465/) on behalf of [Israeli military intelligence](https://www.mintpressnews.com/ari-ben-menashe-jeffrey-epstein-ghislaine-maxwell-israel-intelligence/262162/).

### **Blackmail is Embedded in Our Political Machinery**

Blackmail [has always been used as a weapon](https://www.nakedcapitalism.com/2014/07/exclusive-high-level-nsa-whistleblower-says-blackmail-huge-unreported-part-mass-surveillance.html) by intelligence agencies. It's a method of coercion used to control events from the shadows, providing a window into how elites exercise influence over each other.

Rep. Tim Burchett of Tennessee [recently alleged](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-gop-congressman-stands-accusation-some-fellow-members-have-been-compromised) that many House members were deciding to vote based on "compromising material about them held by powerful interests," both foreign and domestic. American political commentator Jesse Watters [speculated](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-jesse-watters-claims-fbi-cia-can-blackmail-president-with-hunter-bidens-laptop-he-has-do-whatever-they-say) that any criminal information found on Hunter Biden's laptop could provide leverage for blackmailing President Joe Biden.

Blackmail typically involves collecting information that could expose affairs, drug use, sexual abuse, or other illicit activities. By threatening to expose damaging information, blackmailers force their victims to do their bidding.

**Blackmail subverts democracy by compromising government officials, making it impossible for them to serve the interest of the people or perform their duties correctly.** Instead, they’re forced to serve the interests of the blackmailer. Checks and balances can't apply to blackmail.

When government agencies gather intelligence for reasons of national security, we’re told the purpose is to protect us. Our research suggests otherwise. **High-level NSA whistleblowers revealed how mass surveillance is primarily used for political blackmail [with the purpose](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-how-covert-agents-infiltrate-internet-manipulate-deceive-destroy-reputations) of deceiving the public, destroying reputations, protecting criminal activities of the powerful, attacking activist movements, and influencing policies and laws.**

### **NSA and CIA: Spying and Sexual "Honey Traps"**

The CIA [secretly monitored and spied on the Senate intelligence committee](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/mar/05/obama-cia-senate-intelligence-committee-torture), who were tasked with overseeing intelligence agency activities and reigning in abuses of power. The NSA [stockpiled sexually explicit images](https://web.archive.org/web/20140228011904/https://www.startribune.com/world/247581011.html) of ordinary people and [spied on people’s porn habits](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/nsa-porn-muslims_n_4346128) as part of a plan to discredit "radicalizers."

Documents leaked by former NSA contractor and whistleblower Edward Snowden [revealed the scope of illegal, state-sponsored mass surveillance programs](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-ten-years-later-snowdens-heroism-shines-ever-brighter) (although the covert capability to monitor all communications [existed long before Snowden’s revelations](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-echelon-spy-network-revealed)). **[Investigations by the](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/in-nsa-intercepted-data-those-not-targeted-far-outnumber-the-foreigners-who-are/2014/07/05/8139adf8-045a-11e4-8572-4b1b969b6322_story.html)** ***[Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/in-nsa-intercepted-data-those-not-targeted-far-outnumber-the-foreigners-who-are/2014/07/05/8139adf8-045a-11e4-8572-4b1b969b6322_story.html)*** **found that the intercepted communications of ordinary, everyday people with no connection to extremism far outnumbered legally targeted foreign entities.** As former NSA intelligence official and whistleblower [William Binney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Binney_(intelligence_official)) articulated, "[The ultimate goal of the NSA is total population control](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2014/jul/11/the-ultimate-goal-of-the-nsa-is-total-population-control)."

Former NSA analyst and whistleblower [Russ Tice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russ_Tice) suggested that surveillance of high-ranking officials was a common procedure to collect intimate information capable of destroying reputations, inluding [former president Barack Obama](https://reason.com/2013/06/21/did-the-nsa-spy-on-obama/).

> ***I had my hands literally on the paperwork for these sort of things–they went after high-ranking military officers; they went after members of Congress, both Senate and the House, especially on the intelligence committees and on the armed services committees and some of the–and judicial.** They went after lawyers and law firms. They went after judges. One of the judges is now sitting on the Supreme Court that I had his wiretap information in my hand. Two are former FISA court judges. They went after State Department officials. They went after people in the executive service that were part of the White House–their own people. They went after antiwar groups. They went after U.S. banking firms and financial firms that do international business. They went after NGOs that–like the Red Cross, people like that that go overseas and do humanitarian work.* — Russ Tice on the [Sibel Edmonds' Boiling Frogs podcast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sibel_Edmonds) (Sibel Edmond was a former FBI staffer and National Security Whistleblowers Coalition founder)

Snowden’s files revealed the existence of the [Joint Threat Research Intelligence Unit](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-snowden-docs-show-british-spies-used-sex-dirty-tricks), a top secret British spy unit that worked with the NSA to spread false material on the internet in an effort to discredit or destroy reputations. One of the top ways they did this was the use of [sexual "honey traps"](https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2010/12/honey-traps-do-spies-use-sex-to-extract-secrets.html) to snare, blackmail, and influence their targets.

> *Next thing you know, you’re in a hotel room with them, naked. Next thing you know, you’re about to make a key vote, and what happens? Some well-dressed person comes up and whispers into your ear, ‘Hey, man, there’s tapes out on you. Were you in a motel room on whatever with whoever?’ And then you’re, like, ‘Uh-oh.’ And they say, ‘You really ought not be voting for this thing.’* — Rep. Tim Burchett, "[GOP Congressman Stands By Accusation Some Fellow Members Have Been Compromised](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-gop-congressman-stands-accusation-some-fellow-members-have-been-compromised)"

[Operation Midnight Climax](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mk/cia-lsd-sex-climax) was a sub-project of [Project MKULTRA](https://www.wanttoknow.info/military-intelligence-corruption-information#mkultra), the unethical CIA mind-control research program that began in the 1950s. Prostitutes on the CIA payroll were instructed to lure clients, including US and foreign diplomats, back to CIA-run safehouses in New York and San Francisco. They were slipped LSD, and monitored and filmed behind one-way glasses. This program ran for 10 years, [with a purpose](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2017/aug/30/cias-mk-ultra-lsd-mind-control-experiment-has-ling/) to research the power of sexual blackmail, surveillance technology, and the possible use of mind-altering drugs in field operations. CIA agents would later [blackmail diplomats](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/CIA-RDP90-01208R000100250052-9.pdf) into becoming informants.

> *They do not give a damn about the law or the Constitution or the Congress or the Oversight committees except as something to be subverted and manipulated and lied to. They ruin their detractors and they fear the truth. If they can, they will blackmail you. Sex, drugs, deals, whatever it takes."* — Former CIA officer and Iran-Contra whistleblower [Bruce Hemmings](https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/lifestyle/1989/10/03/ex-agent-joins-call-for-cia-watchdog/f42c33b0-8cc1-4c15-95c5-d5547d093811/)

### **J. Edgar Hoover and the FBI's Blackmail Campaign**

J. Edgar Hoover was the first director of the FBI, and served in office for 48 years. [Having been blackmailed himself](https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-02-06-mn-1078-story.html), allegedly by [organized crime figures](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/history/1957-meeting-forced-fbi-recognize-mafiaand-changed-justice-system-forever-180967204/), Hoover understood the power of blackmail intimately.

While he was in power, he was given the green light to engage in unconstitutional, unchecked activities and crimes that involved spying on and collecting intimate information about America’s most powerful. Hoover surveilled politicians, presidents, at least 12 Supreme Court justices, and all types of activists and citizens who he deemed as enemies of the United States. **[An official count](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2012/jan/01/j-edgar-hoover-secret-fbi) found Hoover had 883 files on senators and 722 more on congressmen.**

Every president that Hoover served as FBI director was aware of his illegal activities. President Truman once [wrote in his diary](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2012/jan/01/j-edgar-hoover-secret-fbi) that a secret police or Gestapo wasn’t necessary for protecting establishment power because the FBI’s aggressive surveillance campaign was "dabbling in sex-life scandals and plain blackmail."

When activists broke into an FBI field office and discovered the top-secret [COINTELPRO FBI program](https://www.wanttoknow.info/ia/cointelpro-fbi), it was confirmed that the FBI was spying on and infiltrating civil rights, anti-war and progressive groups to limit their political effectiveness. Senator Frank Church, who headed the first committee to investigate intelligence agency abuses, couldn’t have said it any better: the purpose of COINTELPRO was to destroy lives and ruin reputations.

> *Covert action is nothing more than a semantic disguise for murder, coercion, blackmail, bribery, the spreading of lies, whatever is deemed useful to bending other countries to our will.* — [Senator Frank Church](https://www.thenation.com/article/archive/frank-church-and-abyss-warrantless-wiretapping/)

Hoover had a particular obsession with taking down Martin Luther King Jr., who was seen as a communist because of his passion for transforming economic inequality and ending the US war machine. Soon after Hoover began his vicious surveillance campaign against King, [a blackmail letter was sent](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-burglars-who-took-fbi-abandon-shadows) to King along with a tape allegedly recording his extramarital affairs.  [The letter denounced him](https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/retropolis/wp/2017/12/13/an-old-letter-sheds-light-on-fbis-malice-toward-martin-luther-king-jr/) as a "a colossal fraud . . . and a dissolute, abnormal moral imbecile ... Your 'honorary degrees,' your Nobel Prize (What a grim farce) . . . will not save you ... You are done ... There is only one thing left for you to do," the letter said. "You know what it is . . . There is but one way out . . . You better take it before your filthy, abnormal, fraudulent self is bared to the nation."

Anthony Summers, a Pulitzer Prize Finalist, wrote a [biography](https://www.amazon.com/Official-Confidential-Secret-Edgar-Hoover/dp/1480435201/ref=tmm_pap_swatch_0) on Hoover based on hundreds of insider interviews and secret documents. In his book, he wrote about Senator Edward Long, a Democrat from Missouri, who was going to conduct hearings on the FBI’s warrantless wiretapping activities.

> *A senior Hoover aide came to call, and the conversation went as follows: "Senator, I think you ought to read this file that we have on you. You know we would never use it, because you're a friend of ours… We just thought you ought to know the type of stuff that might get around and might be harmful to you… They handed him the folder… Long read it for a few minutes. [Then] they went on their way. **The next thing I knew we had orders to skip over the FBI inquiries.**"* — Anthony Summers, "[The secret life of J Edgar Hoover](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2012/jan/01/j-edgar-hoover-secret-fbi)"

**An important final note**

The risks and dangers of bribery are well understood in politics, yet the risks and dangers of blackmail are hidden and may be much more significant. Most of us want to believe that our government is run on democratic values. Yet so often, these values take a backseat to the hidden agendas of special interests seeming to be above the law.

content_markdown:
[YouTube video: bOT0tPeQwzI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOT0tPeQwzI&t=0s)

The U.S. military and intelligence agencies have [billions of dollars’ worth of secret projects](https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-srv/special/national/black-budget/) they don’t want you to know about. These billions have funded a secret world of advanced science, technology, weapons, and various covert activities, which have always been shielded from congressional oversight and public scrutiny. Back in the 90s, Members of the House Armed Services Committee once said that [70 percent of the black budget could be declassified at no risk to national security.](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/CIA-RDP90-00965R000707040013-3.pdf)

**Our taxpayer dollars are partly funding these black budget programs, and we have a right to know what we’re paying for. So why the secrecy? What is being kept hidden from the public?**

This is why we’re interviewing private pilot and military aerospace historian [Michael Schratt](https://www.youtube.com/@michaelschrattofficial), who’s investigated top secret advanced technologies buried deep within the military-intelligence complex for over 25 years. He alleges to have first-hand experience with classified government black budget programs, with access to former US Air Force pilots, retired Naval personnel and former aerospace engineers with top-secret clearance.

He’s one of the leading authority voices in investigating government programs that involve the recovery and study of off-world technology, also known as UAP/UFO crash retrieval programs. He’s author of *[DARK FILES](https://www.amazon.com/DARK-FILES-Pictorial-Forgotten-Encounters/dp/0578369265/ref=sr_1_1)*, which brings to life historically significant and credible UFO cases obtained from university archives, research centers, and private collections using carefully re-constructed illustrations of the events.

Whether it's advanced military aircraft or serious signs of extraterrestrial life, the implications are too profound to ignore. **Michael is suggesting that publicly known technology and weapons programs might be fronts for black budget operations dealing with technologies way more advanced than the public is aware of.**

[Join us in this fascinating 38-min video interview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOT0tPeQwzI), with many images and videos throughout to verify and illustrate the points being discussed.

**Our 38-min interview covers the topics below, which you can follow along at the Youtube link:**

> • Introduction to the military-industrial complex and the black budget world
> • What drew Michael Schratt to studying advanced black budget technologies and UFO phenomena
> • If you could declassify one technology developed under a black budget program, what would it be and why?
> • Out of all the advanced technologies in use on Earth, how much has ET influence?
> • UFO/UAP crash retrieval programs
> • Top secret technologies kept hidden from the public
> • The infamous Tic Tac video: a UFO, reverse-engineered craft, experimental military tech, or all of the above?
> • US military bases purported to study ET tech and house advanced technologies
> • How can the most powerful technologies help humanity instead of harm?
> • How to balance disclosure with national security obligations
> • Michael’s thoughts on the [UAP Disclosure Act](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ngn0LimfRDE&)
> • What keeps Michael inspired and hopeful

For more, check out our [WantToKnow.info UFO Information Center](https://www.wanttoknow.info/ufo-information-center).

title: How Elections and Both Political
content_markdown:
As the election draws near, I believe we can safeguard democracy and the greater good *regardless of who’s elected into office*. One thing we must guard against is the social polarization so evident in major events such as the recent attempted assassination of Donald Trump.

[Studies show that times of crisis can bring us together in profound ways](https://hbr.org/2020/03/how-bad-times-bring-out-the-best-in-people). Tapping into the human instinct for connection and collaboration requires that we heal the forces keeping us divided and ask the deeper questions mainstream media ignores.

This article delves into three important dimensions of this conversation: **the root causes of America's polarization and division, the pervasive election corruption across both political parties, and the hidden powers that maintain control regardless of who’s elected in office.** In our closing, we emphasize that the solutions are out there. The greater good and what’s possible are waiting for us.

### **What’s Driving the Polarization and Division in America?**

Journalist and author Batya Ungar-Sargon asked this question as she traveled the country, engaging with everyday Americans to uncover their perspectives on the political, economic, and cultural landscape. Contrary to mainstream media narratives, she [found deep consensus](https://www.rnz.co.nz/national/programmes/afternoons/audio/2018934485/how-class-not-politics-is-dividing-america) on the most important issues between working class Democrats and working class Republicans. Communities across the country were more diverse and open to viewpoint diversity than she previously thought.

In her book *[Second Class: How the Elites Betrayed America's Working Men and Women](https://www.encounterbooks.com/books/second-class/)*, she writes that the major driver of polarization isn’t political division, but the class division between the elite control regime and the working class. **Both political parties serve the interests of these powerful elites, and not the needs of the larger common good.** The raging culture war around political identity is little more than a tool used by the powerful to corrupt the media and both sides of the political aisle, resulting in the working class endlessly fighting each other.

**In short, it’s not the Blue or Red party but the [Money party behind most political decisions](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mk/liftingtheveil#2).**

[A study by Princeton University](https://www.bbc.com/news/blogs-echochambers-27074746) found that the US is not a democracy, but an oligarchy dominated by the rich and powerful elite. Over the past decade, the [wealth of the global top 1% grew by $42 trillion](https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/25/economy/wealth-tax-super-rich-oxfam-report). The COVID economy led to the [greatest wealth transfer in history](https://www.newsweek.com/were-living-through-greatest-transfer-wealth-middle-class-elites-history-opinion-1641614). We've borrowed so much money to finance wars that interest payments on these debts [now exceed the entire cost of our national defense spending](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-us-federal-budget-crosses-grim-milestone-as-interest-payments-overtake-defense-spending), which amounts to trillions of dollars. Inflation spun out of control, largely due to [rampant corporate price gouging](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-down-with-corporate-pricegougers-ripping-us-off) that made it harder for average people to make ends meet.

Billionaires and large corporations now wield enormous power and influence in all sectors of society–technology, banking, media, food, medicine, national security, the criminal justice system. **This centralization of power and wealth happened under every presidential administration.**

In the last century, [Republican and Democrat presidents have pursued a broadly similar political agenda](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mk/liftingtheveil#2). This agenda has benefitted elites at the expense of the general public. Loyalty to this agenda takes precedence over party loyalty. This naturally raises the question: who is really shaping American policies? We’ll address this below.

### **Election Corruption On Both Sides of Political Aisle**

**Domestically, election corruption happens on both sides of the political aisle. Internationally, covert forces within the US government manipulate elections and governments all over the world, [supporting fascists, drug lords, and terrorists](https://www.salon.com/2014/03/08/35_countries_the_u_s_has_backed_international_crime_partner/).** Carnegie Mellon University researcher Dov Levin [tracked more than 80 times](https://www.npr.org/2016/12/22/506625913/database-tracks-history-of-u-s-meddling-in-foreign-elections) that the US has interfered in elections of other countries between 1946 and 2000. Ex-CIA director James Woolsey [even admitted](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-excia-director-says-us-meddles-a-good-cause) that they meddle in other countries’ elections “for a good cause.”

In the 2000 election, Al Gore won the popular vote but a Supreme Court decision gave the presidency to George W. Bush. Among the many controversies of this election, it was discovered that tens of thousands of eligible voters in Florida were [wrongly prevented from voting](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2000/dec/10/columnists.theobserver). These voters were predominantly Democrats, Blacks and Hispanics, and people from low-income communities. **Florida Governor Jeb Bush and Secretary of State Katherine Harris paid a private data firm Database Technologies to target and remove eligible voters,** including people whose voting rights were restored after they served their sentences and those who were innocent yet accused of committing felonies. The illegal purging of these voters significantly impacted the election outcome.

Following this irregular election, the Bush administration started a disastrous war on terror and invaded Iraq under false pretenses, resulting in countless crimes against humanity. [4.5 million people](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-time-reassess-war-terror) have directly and indirectly been killed as a result of the US post-9/11 wars.

In the 2016 election, [leaked emails revealed that the Democratic primary was rigged from the start](https://www.salon.com/2016/03/30/10_ways_the_democratic_primary_has_been_rigged_from_the_start_partner/). **The Democratic National Committee (DNC), the Hilary Clinton campaign, and major news outlets [colluded to prevent Bernie Sanders](https://www.rt.com/usa/352752-dnc-leaks-clinton-collusion/) from winning his party’s nomination.**

Unlike Sanders, Clinton was in deep with the military-industrial complex, having recently approved $165 billion worth of commercial [arms sales to Clinton Foundation donors](https://www.sfchronicle.com/opinion/article/Questions-about-arms-deals-for-Clinton-Foundation-6292996.php) while Secretary of State. She fully supported former president and husband Bill Clinton’s crime legislation in 1994, which ultimately became one of the [main drivers of modern mass incarceration](https://web.archive.org/web/20160308141205/https://www.thenation.com/article/hillary-clinton-does-not-deserve-black-peoples-votes/) that devastated predominantly Black communities. The Clintons politically profited from the [dirty fossil-fuel industry](https://web.archive.org/web/20160418154912/https://www.thenation.com/article/the-problem-with-hillary-clinton-isnt-just-her-corporate-cash-its-her-corporate-worldview/) and [CIA-backed organized crime operations](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mindfulnewsbrief/how-the-deep-state-won-the-war-on-drugs) that trafficked drugs through Arkansas as part of the Iran-Contra scandal. Ironically, [Iran-Contra](https://www.counterpunch.org/2014/10/29/the-cia-the-contras-and-drugs/) was largely carried out by prominent right-wing forces to maintain the US position of global dominance.

Bernie Sanders represented something different. He was catalyzing a populist revolution to create a fairer economy by ending the [rampant greed, corruption and fraud](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-bernie-sanders-rein-wall-street-fix-fed) that pervaded [Wall Street and corporate America](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2016/jan/05/bernie-sanders-wall-street-reform-plan-hillary-clinton). He was a passionate voice for the [working class](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-senator-bernie-sanders-war-between-middle-class-wealthy) and a real advocate for [environmental justice](https://archive.nytimes.com/www.nytimes.com/politics/first-draft/2016/04/11/bernie-sanders-proposes-fracking-ban-and-attacks-hillary-clinton-on-the-environment/).

During the election, Sanders’ growing popularity was [subject to a media blackout](https://tonybrasunas.medium.com/the-great-recognition-of-2016-nixon-level-corruption-in-the-dnc-means-its-time-to-build-a-new-29cb9dd83001#), while he was [strategically smeared and discredited by the press](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/wikileaks-emails-show-dnc-favored-hillary-clinton-over_b_57930be0e4b0e002a3134b05).

> *The media began counting superdelegates [for Clinton] in October as if they’d already voted even though today they still haven’t; the DNC performed something shockingly similar to money laundering for the Clinton campaign to circumvent donation maximums and funnel millions to her campaign; the debates were reduced, canceled, or scheduled at times few people would watch, which prevented Bernie Sanders from becoming better known earlier in the primary; and the primary rules as a whole were [written and rewritten](https://web.archive.org/web/20160718185823/https://www.usuncut.com/politics/debbie-wasserman-schultz-hillary-clinton/) by DNC Chair Debbie Wasserman-Schultz … a longtime Clinton friend and ally. **Even worse: voter rolls were mysteriously [purged](http://www.motherjones.com/politics/2016/04/new-york-primary-voter-purge) in many states; caucus rules were [changed](http://www.commondreams.org/views/2016/05/18/how-democrats-manipulated-nevada-state-party-convention-then-blamed-sanders-chaos) suddenly; and actual votes were [flipped](https://richardcharnin.wordpress.com/2016/06/24/smoking-gun-approximately-15-of-bernies-votes-were-flipped-to-clinton-in-california/) by the thousands in many states, according to scientific analysis.***
> — journalist and media activist Tony Brasunas, “[The Deeper Reason Many Intelligent Progressives and Independents Will Not Support Hillary Clinton](https://tonybrasunas.medium.com/the-deeper-reason-independents-and-progressives-will-not-support-hillary-clinton-db79a10b23c7)”

Mainstream media, US intelligence agencies, and establishment leaders [attributed the leaked emails to a Russian conspiracy](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-our-spy-intelligence-agencies-out-control) aimed at interfering in U.S. elections and damaging Hillary Clinton's reputation to benefit Donald Trump. **Yet no evidence was found to support this claim. Even more damning, these allegations turned out to be a product of government disinformation. Clinton’s campaign [manufactured and paid for the Russian collusion hoax](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-whos-real-purveyor-disinformation-your-government), which costed taxpayers millions of dollars.** Investigation into the matter produced the Mueller Report and Durham Report, both of which failed to produce any evidence of Russian collusion. FBI agent Kevin Clinesmith even [lied to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court](https://www.justice.gov/usao-ct/pr/fbi-attorney-admits-altering-email-used-fisa-application-during-crossfire-hurricane) on an application related to spying on individuals suspected of Russian collusion.

**This should’ve been a major story, but it wasn’t. [Former NPR veteran reporter Uri Berliner](https://www.thefp.com/p/npr-editor-how-npr-lost-americas-trust) couldn’t believe that the media was burying this story. Where was the mainstream media coverage on these revelations of blatant Democratic Party lies?**

Interestingly enough, Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist Seymour Hersh [alleges](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-seth-rich-conspiracy-theorists-russiagate-truthers) that DNC staffer Seth Rich leaked the damning documents. After [Rich was shot and killed in DC](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/man-shot-killed-in-northwest-dc/2074048/) in an apparent robbery, Wikileaks founder Julian Assange [strongly implied](https://youtu.be/Kp7FkLBRpKg?si=er9q8R2OJ6ysVXf3) that Rich had been the source and that his untimely death may have been related to that.

### **Why Hidden Forces Within Government Remain in Control No Matter Who is Elected into Office**

> *This machinery is inaccessible by design. How we vote is irrelevant to its operations, yet we're told that voting is the only way we can change things. So we vote for the big stone heads. And we ignore the machinery supporting the big stone heads, hidden from view.*
> – WantToKnow.info news editor Mark Bailey, [Free Mind Gazette Substack](https://freemindgazette.substack.com/p/context-basics)

Elections are meant to serve the interests of the people. In theory, they’re the primary mechanism by which public will is translated into representative governance. In practical terms, elections may be less important than we’ve been led to believe.

Taking a sober look at the state of our society, our greatest problems have remained unaddressed election cycle after election cycle. Republicans and Democrats have both proven themselves equally unwilling to solve these problems. Issues like chronic illness, intelligence agency abuses, Big Tech corruption, and the war machine are rarely mentioned on the campaign trail. These issues negatively impact us all, yet they’re ignored by presidential debates because they’re also profitable components of the machinery of power.

#### **Presidents on both sides of the political aisle consistently fail to address the [chronic illness and disease](https://www.wanttoknow.info/healthnewsstories) in our country**

In the US, we spend far more on healthcare ([$4.3 trillion](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2022-12-21/the-4-3-trillion-us-health-care-tapeworm-keeps-growing)) than on defense ([$1.3 trillion](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--pentagon-budget-1-trillion-looming-heres-how-stop-it)). Yet we have the [poorest health outcomes](https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/31/health/us-health-care-spending-global-perspective/index.html) among high-income countries. In 1960, only 6% of American kids lived with a chronic health condition. Today, [it is more than half](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-more-than-half-young-us-adults-have-chronic-health-condition). No US president has addressed the [root causes of our health crisis](https://www.wanttoknow.info/health/why-our-children-are-sick-lessons-from-health-freedom-conference), which aren’t mysterious. Giant corporations that place profits ahead of people control our [food](https://blog.ucsusa.org/karen-perry-stillerman/what-is-big-ag-and-why-should-you-be-worried-about-them/) and [healthcare systems](https://www.wanttoknow.info/pharmaceuticalcorruptionnewsstories).

Corporate profiteers in the junk food industry [reap profits](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-weight-loss-drugs-go-handinhand-with-junk-food-industry) from the weight-loss industry, in which [1 in 8 American adults](https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/10/health/ozempic-glp-1-survey-kff/index.html) have taken a weight-loss drug. [Congress protected Big Pharma](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-new-book-chronicles-how-americas-opioid-industry-operated-like-drug-cartel) when they exacerbated the deadly War on Drugs and made billions from opioid prescriptions, only to then [sell drugs to treat opioid addiction](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-purdue-pharma-sought-secret-plan-become-endtoend-pain-provider-lawsuit-alleges).

[Toxic chemicals](https://www.wanttoknow.info/toxic-chemicalsnewsstories) in our food and everyday products are linked to [devastating chronic diseases](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-reducing-pesticides-food-major-food-manufacturers-earn-f-grade), [irreversible consequences for children’s health](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2018/oct/24/entire-pesticide-class-should-be-banned-for-effect-on-childrens-health), and [major environmental destruction](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/us-pesticide-regulation-is-failing-the-hardest-hit-communities-its-time-to-fix-it/). **Some of these chemicals are [banned on golf courses](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-its-time-ban-paraquat) because of how toxic they are, but they’re approved for use on farms that grow our food.** Meanwhile, [billions of pounds of pesticides](https://www.levernews.com/toxic-harvest/) are used each year on our food despite their use being identified as a [cancer risk comparable to smoking](https://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/4792919-pesticides-cancer-link-study/).

**The corporations controlling our food system have done everything in their power to prevent us from adopting healthier alternatives to their dangerous products.** They’ve [corrupted](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-monsanto-the-merchants-poison) scientists and politicians, manipulated public opinion, and [systematically attacked the organic food movement](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/monsanto-fingerprints-fou_b_10757524).

Yet the organic food movement is a [game-changing remedy](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-health-benefits-organic-food-farming-outlined-new-report) to start addressing our health crisis. Studies show that toxic pesticide levels [dropped by 60%](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-study-shows-toxic-pesticide-levels-families-dropped-60-after-oneweek-organic-diet) after eating an organic diet for just one week. Organic food is also linked to [significantly lower cancer risk](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-you-can-cut-your-cancer-risk-eating-organic-new-study-says) and is effective in [treating](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-balinese-foundation-treats-autistic-children-with-organic-food) and [reducing the severity](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--miracle-cured-my-sons-autism-was-our-kitchen) of autism in children. [Organic and regenerative agriculture](https://www.wanttoknow.info/articlesearch?aq=regenerative%20%20agriculture%20cats=&%20date=&sort=) can radically [boost local economies](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-how-organic-agriculture-boosts-local-economies) and reverse environmental damage. [French farmers are even being paid to go organic](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--keep-clean-drinking-water-flowing-paris-farmers-going-organic) by the government as part of a larger effort to clean up water pollution. Why aren’t our leaders talking about this?

**[We have the solutions to make America healthier again](https://www.wanttoknow.info/healing-our-bodiesnewsstories). These solutions can unite us across our differences. When we can think and feel well together, that’s a double win for the common good.**

#### **Presidents on both sides of the political aisle have [deep ties to Big Tech](https://www.wanttoknow.info/big-technewsstories)**

It doesn’t matter to Big Tech who wins the presidential nomination. This past year, the nation’s largest tech companies [spent $28 million](https://www.businessinsider.com/how-much-tech-companies-tesla-amazon-meta-microsoft-spend-lobbying-2024-5) to persuade lawmakers and regulators from both sides of the political aisle to let them continue what they're doing unregulated. Big Tech even [paid high-level intelligence and national security officials](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-intelligence-officials-secretly-paid-big-tech-fight-antitrust-reforms) to help stop legislative efforts that would break up Big Tech’s unfair control over the market. In the last four years, every major tech antitrust and competition bill in Congress has died.

The world’s biggest tech companies are [becoming more powerful than most countries](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-big-tech-companies-becoming-more-powerful-than-nationstates). With so much power in their hands, Big Tech has [punished](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--college-professor-wants-use-section-230-against-big-tech) those who create public tools that reduce screen addiction and allow people to take back control of their social media feeds. By controlling the smartphone app store market, Apple and Google removed apps that offered alternative forms of social media. These alternatives could have challenged the [collusion between Big Tech and high-level government officials](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-stop-mourning-murthy-case-start-fighting-censorshipindustrial-complex) to [censor social media content](https://www.wanttoknow.info/censorshipnewsarticles) and [the capture of our personal information](https://www.theguardian.com/books/2019/oct/04/shoshana-zuboff-surveillance-capitalism-assault-human-automomy-digital-privacy) to sell it to other companies and influence our behavior.

**[We've documented countless examples of how Big Tech violates human and environmental rights](https://www.wanttoknow.info/big-technewsstories). Both political parties do very little to hold them accountable. Instead, our elected officials are standing by as these companies become deeply embedded within the [military-industrial](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-report-sounds-alarm-over-growing-role-big-tech-us-militaryindustrial-complex) and [law enforcement world](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-why-big-tech-cops-spies-were-made-one-another).**

[Facial recognition software](https://www.wanttoknow.info/articlesearch?aq=facial%20recognition&cats=&date=&sort=pub) is being deployed everywhere, even as it often [misidentifies innocent people](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-i-was-misidentified-as-shoplifter-facial-recognition-tech), [disproportionately affecting Black communities](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-fantasy-fears-about-ai-obscuring-how-we-already-abuse-machine-intelligence). Lethal AI weapons systems are [rapidly being developed for wartime](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-ais-oppenheimer-moment-autonomous-weapons-enter-battlefield), posing a grave risk to innocent civilians and armed service members. And who knows what else? [Thousands of Big Tech’s military and law enforcement contracts go unreported](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-new-records-show-google-microsoft-amazon-have-thousands-previously-unreported-military-law-enforcement-contracts).

> *AI doesn’t cause harm by itself. We should worry about the people who control it. We live in societies in which power is exercised by a few to the detriment of the majority, and that technology provides a means of consolidating that power.*
> – journalist [Kenan Malik](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-ai-doesnt-cause-harm-itself-we-should-worry-about-people-who-control-it)

When used wisely and consciously, [technology and social media are powerful forces for good](https://www.wanttoknow.info/tech-for-goodnewsarticles). They harness life-enhancing human creativity and innovation, ideally contributing to a global commons that can bring us together. Biomimicry is a [growing field of study](https://www.miragenews.com/how-nature-inspires-technology-the-field-of-1023128) that merges technology and the natural world to solve global and environmental challenges by [drawing inspiration](https://biomimicry.org/) from nature and living species.

[Taiwanese government officials worked with a decentralized civic tech community](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-how-taiwans-civic-hackers-helped-find-new-way-run-country) to address increasing political division by asking, "*How do we find a way not to measure division, but construct consensus?*" This led to a social media platform that hosted online spaces for debate where comments that were consensus-oriented got the most visibility. **What they found was that within a few weeks, they could clearly identify where most people agree on many different issues. Politicians used this process to create outcomes the government could actually act on. Dozens of laws have now been passed based on what they found through this process.**

Who are the tech companies in the US working on similar initiatives?

#### **Presidents on both sides of the political aisle fail to hold US intelligence agencies accountable for their [abuses and crimes against humanity](https://www.wanttoknow.info/intelligenceagencynewsstories)**

The CIA and other intelligence agencies have a long history of abusing their powers. Administration after administration has failed to hold these agencies accountable for their crimes. The CIA’s infamous [MKULTRA mind control program](https://www.wanttoknow.info/military-intelligence-corruption-information#mkultra) began under Eisenhower in 1953 and continued into the Nixon administration twenty years later. **US intelligence agencies have also [trafficked drugs to finance black budget programs](https://www.wanttoknow.info/mindfulnewsbrief/how-the-deep-state-won-the-war-on-drugs), established a [network of secret torture prisons](https://www.wanttoknow.info/military-intelligence-corruption-information#torture) that mass produced human rights violations, and [erased the expectation of privacy](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-cias-surveillance-state-operating-against-us-all) with their mass surveillance operations.** The CIA has been involved in [assassination programs](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-how-cia-destabilizes-world) and the collection of [sexual blackmail, which was used to manipulate government officials at home and abroad](https://peerservice.substack.com/p/epstein-was-just-the-tip-of-the-iceberg). They infiltrated the media to shape public opinion during [Operation Mockingbird](https://www.wanttoknow.info/military-intelligence-corruption-information#mockingbird) and targeted domestic dissidents, anti-war activists, and other progressive movements under [Operation CHAOS](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/CIA-RDP90-01208R000100170047-4.pdf).

In 2020, 51 members of the intelligence community attempted to mislead the public by publishing a letter [falsely suggesting that the Hunter Biden laptop was Russian disinformation](https://nypost.com/2023/04/20/biden-campaign-pushed-spies-to-write-false-hunter-laptop-letter/) while the CIA [financed social media spying tools](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-did-intellinked-dataminr-play-sinister-role-hunter-biden-laptop-suppression) to censor anyone who investigated the [potentially incriminating contents](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-chinese-fund-backed-hunter-biden-invested-major-chinese-surveillance-firm) on Biden’s laptop. Around the same time, intelligence agencies began taking more direct control of public discourse by [actively censoring the internet and manipulating social media](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-ctil-files-1-us-uk-military-contractors-created-sweeping-plan-global-censorship-2018-new-documents-show).

In light of all we now know, our intelligence agencies appear untrustworthy and unreliable. This is of grave concern, because these are the very agencies our leaders rely on for answers to hard questions about what’s going on in the world and what should be done about it. Intelligence agency power abuses aren’t inevitable. But stopping them will require more than electing a new president.

#### **Presidents on both sides of the political aisle [support the war machine](https://www.wanttoknow.info/military-intelligence-corruption-information)**

Barack Obama was elected on a platform of bringing peace to our world. While Obama slashed the number of US troops in war zones, he [expanded the role of high-tech special operations and paved the way for automated warfare](https://www.latimes.com/projects/la-na-pol-obama-at-war/). **His administration’s [secret drone program](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--army-chaplain-who-quit-over-unaccountable-killing-obamas-secretive-drone-program) killed thousands of innocent civilians in at least 7 countries, including [drone-bombing funerals](https://www.salon.com/2012/06/04/obama_again_bombs_mourners/) and [targeting those who show up at the scene of an original attack](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2012/aug/20/us-drones-strikes-target-rescuers-pakistan) to rescue the wounded and remove the dead.**

Donald Trump continued the [expansion of the military-industrial complex](https://www.politico.com/news/2020/09/08/trump-military-defense-industry-booster-410396) and the [use of deadly drone strikes across the globe](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-22-years-drone-warfare-no-end-sight). Trump [repeatedly claimed Saudi Arabia was behind 9/11](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/2016/02/donald-trump-suggests-the-saudis-did-911.html) and slammed Hilary Clinton for accepting money from the Saudis, given their horrific treatment of women [among other human rights violations](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--american-pr-firm-helping-saudi-arabia-clean-up-its-image). Yet once elected, he [pushed through weapons sales of $500 million](https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/13/world/middleeast/trump-weapons-saudi-arabia.html) to the kingdom while [receiving lavish personal gifts](https://www.thedailybeast.com/the-insane-gifts-saudi-arabia-gave-president-trump) from its rulers.

The Biden administration and the U.S. Congress [passed the largest Pentagon budget ever](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-congress-moves-boost-bidens-record-defense-budget-2022-06-22/). Biden [authorized the transfer of cluster bombs](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-cluster-bombs-as-outdated-as-war) to Ukraine. Cluster bombs are an internationally banned weapon due to how they kill and maim indiscriminately over a wide area and for years after a conflict, **[with children being the primary victims](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/07/14/us-cluster-munition-transfer-ukraine-ignores-history-civilian-harm).** Biden also oversaw the delivery of billions in military aid to Israel as Israel was attacking Hamas in Gaza, killing tens of thousands of civilians in the process.

**Who are the winners of these bipartisan, endless wars? Financiers and defense contractors, a group that now includes [Big Tech](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-report-sounds-alarm-over-growing-role-big-tech-us-militaryindustrial-complex) and [venture capitalists](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-new-spin-a-revolving-door-pentagon-officials-turned-venture-capitalists) paving the way for an [unprecedented AI arms race](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-ais-oppenheimer-moment-autonomous-weapons-enter-battlefield). The [revolving door between contractors and government offices](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--publicly-funded-defense-contractor-revolving-door) makes meaningful regulation of these contractors all but impossible.** [Recent bipartisan legislation](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-new-bipartisan-bill-allows-military-contractors-fleece-taxpayers) has made it even easier for contractors to fleece taxpayers.

> – activist and author Arundhati Roy

All over the world, [people are healing the war machine in inspiring ways](https://www.wanttoknow.info/healing-the-war-machinenewsstories).

### **Ending The Culture Wars for the Greater Good of All**

> *We are a people divided, living under the twin tyrannies of government and big business, in the context of ecological collapse and geopolitical instability. Looking soberly at this invites us to begin taking responsibility for our part in it. More than anything, this new era demands healing, in both an individual and a social sense.*
> – WantToKnow.info news editor Mark Bailey, [Free Mind Gazette Substack](https://freemindgazette.substack.com/p/doing-good-in-a-bad-machine)

In other words, the common good falls by the wayside while government officials further consolidate their power, and corporate profiteers make more money.

Social polarization stifles community and democracy itself. As we sit around [speculating on the dangers of Project 2025](https://scheerpost.com/2024/07/12/project-2025-is-just-project-1981/) or worshiping the presidential candidate who we deem as the “savior” to our country’s problems, **what if we start turning to each other, and not just within our own echo chambers? The most important issues shaping our collective future affect all of us, and we may have more in common than we think.**

[By opening ourselves up to the good and possible](https://www.wanttoknow.info/inspirational), we can start healing the fears that stifle critical thinking and begin tapping into our innate creativity and wisdom.**

In our conversations and in our actions, we can begin noticing where we fall into dualistic thinking (either/or, us vs. them, left/blue), do our best to understand and have compassion for our differences, and bring our focus back to the collective and democratic values that bring us all together. Let’s end these culture wars for the health of our communities and planet.

*We go beyond today's headlines to uncover the hidden forces shaping history and driving global events today, regardless of who's elected in office. Our organization serves a dual purpose: exposing verifiable information on **high level corruption and cover-ups** and **highlighting the best of humanity** with solutions and stories that remind us of our innate goodness and collective power. We have a [comprehensive database of over 13+ news articles](https://www.wanttoknow.info/db-public/artwtk), which has been used by thousands of journalists, researchers, and everyday truth seekers since our founding.*

Communities across the country were more diverse and open to viewpoint diversity than she previously thought. Both political parties serve the interests of these powerful elites, and not the needs of the larger common good. The raging culture war around political identity is little more than a tool used by the powerful to corrupt the media and both sides of the political aisle, resulting in the working class endlessly fighting each other. We've borrowed so much money to finance wars that interest payments on these debts now exceed the entire cost of our national defense spending , which amounts to trillions of dollars. Inflation spun out of control, largely due to rampant corporate price gouging that made it harder for average people to make ends meet. Billionaires and large corporations now wield enormous power and influence in all sectors of society–technology, banking, media, food, medicine, national security, the criminal justice system. This centralization of power and wealth happened under every presidential administration. In the last century, Republican and Democrat presidents have pursued a broadly similar political agenda . This agenda has benefitted elites at the expense of the general public. Loyalty to this agenda takes precedence over party loyalty. content_markdown:
More than half of children in the US have a chronic illness, cancer rates are skyrocketing, and the loneliness epidemic carries health risks as deadly as smoking. Yet what if the negative news overload on America’s chronic illness crisis isn’t the full story?

[We have the solutions to make America healthier again](https://www.wanttoknow.info/healing-our-bodiesnewsstories).

At PEERS and [WantToKnow.info](https://www.wanttoknow.info/), we’ve documented countless stories and news articles that prove human creativity has already developed the tools necessary to transform our health for the better.

Most importantly, these solutions can unite us across our differences in the face of the political polarization exacerbated by the upcoming election. **When we can think and feel well together, that’s a double win for the common good.** Let’s explore the possibilities already in motion!

### **Social and Green Prescriptions**

The average American today spends nearly [90 percent](https://www.washingtonpost.com/wellness/2024/08/04/outdoor-nature-children-cognition-stress/) of their time indoors.

Getting to the bottom of America’s health crisis requires more than traditional drugs and therapies. A transformative movement is gaining momentum: [social prescriptions](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-when-prescription-for-dance-class-not-pill). All over the country, healthcare practitioners, doctors, universities and insurance providers are connecting patients to a wide range of non-clinical services that boost well-being and community. Social prescriptions practice has already been adopted in more than 20 other countries, and it’s proved to be effective in reducing doctor visits and hospital admissions.

These prescriptions are [changing the game and building deep community](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-arts-prescription-embracing-new-culture-health-with-social-prescribing), with patients reporting lower rates of pain, addiction, criminal behaviors, and depression. Older adults are more likely to have better memory, life satisfaction, and overall experiences of aging.

Social prescriptions include vouchers for the local farmer’s market, dance classes, glassblowing workshops, concerts, museum exhibitions and other cultural-social activities. An older man was diagnosed with depression after his wife died. [Through social prescribing](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-social-prescribing-looks-beyond-medicine-nonclinical-methods-treatment), he was connected with a fishing rod and a fishing buddy. It didn't take long for him to get off his medication and build deep friendships in his community.

"[Green prescriptions](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-with-green-prescriptions-getting-healthier-a-walk-the-park)” connect people with nature through hiking, walking, gardening, and outdoor recreational activities. In New Zealand, green prescriptions have become a formal part of the healthcare system. Over 4,000 green prescriptions have been written by over 10,000 physicians in all 10 provinces of Canada.

### **Building Community to Heal the Loneliness Crisis**

Japan and the UK have appointed a Minister of Loneliness to address the global loneliness epidemic, where loneliness can [significantly increase](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-surgeon-general-declares-loneliness-epidemic) risks of heart disease, stroke, dementia, and premature death. Yet all around the globe, people are reviving community and forging deep connections amid the loneliness crisis.

The [Offline Club](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-dutch-digital-detoxers-unplug-en-masse-will-world-follow) is a cafe in Amsterdam that encourages people to unplug from their digital lives and nurture moments of quiet introspection, spontaneous conversations with strangers, creative pursuits like reading and art projects, and more. “Umuganda,” a Kinyarwanda term meaning “coming together in common purpose,” is a [powerful monthly event](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--monthly-ritual-selflessness-has-transformed-rwanda) where Rwandans from across the country gather together to engage in community projects together. These monthly gatherings have played a vital role in helping the community heal and rebuild after the devastating genocide.

In a unique movement that began in 2017, residents in Paris have created the [République des Hyper Voisins, or Republic of Super Neighbors](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-its-beautiful-thing-how-one-paris-district-rediscovered-conviviality), where community members gather for shared meals, skills exchange, mutual support, and public space clean-ups. One of their shared meals consisted of a 700 ft long banquet table on an inner city street, with over 600 chairs and home cooked food. A man who runs a cafe in the area said: **“I’d never seen anything like it before … It felt like the street belonged to me, to all of us."**

The [Library of Things](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-these-public-libraries-for-snowshoes-ukuleles) movement brings people together to share their resources with each other—from tools, technology, a teaching kitchen, science equipment, and other items that many people only need for a single use or can't afford. [Shareable](https://www.shareable.net/), a nonprofit news and action hub promoting people-powered solutions for the common good, has put together [300 guides](https://www.shareable.net/how-to-share/) to help communities thrive through sharing networks.

The [time banking movement](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-banking-most-valuable-currency-time) is a social initiative where people exchange services based on the time spent helping each other—from helping people file their taxes, repairing a roof, keeping someone company, babysitting, offering musical lessons or legal advice, and so much more. By valuing all types of work equally, time banking fosters deep collaboration and community building.

> *Five core principles ... guide time banks to this day: First, everyone has something to contribute. Second, valuing volunteering as “work.” Third, reciprocity or a “pay-it-forward” ethos. Fourth, community building, and fifth, mutual accountability and respect. **Many years ago, a woman ... said to [civil rights lawyer] Edgar Cahn, ‘I have nothing to give.’ Edgar Cahn listened and finally responded, ‘You have love to give.’ And the whole room just went silent.*** — Excerpt from "[Banking the Most Valuable Currency: Time](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-banking-most-valuable-currency-time)"

### **Regenerative Agriculture, Organic Food and the Planetary Health Diet**

Conventional industrial agriculture has given corporate forces immense power over our food system, leading to widespread ecosystem degradation through practices that prioritize short-term profits over long-term sustainability. Yet [regenerative agriculture offers a transformative alternative](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-we-need-regenerative-farming-not-geoengineering) by [empowering local communities](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-how-organic-agriculture-boosts-local-economies), enhancing biodiversity, and restoring soil health. [French farmers are even being paid to go organic](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--keep-clean-drinking-water-flowing-paris-farmers-going-organic) by the government as part of a larger effort to clean up water pollution.

Specifically related to health, regenerative agriculture produces [significantly more nutritious food](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-this-way-farming-really-sexy-rise-regenerative-agriculture) than conventional farming methods, which often rely on toxic fertilizers and pesticides that compromise soil health and [deplete the nutritional quality of crops](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--big-idea-small-farms-how-link-agriculture-nutrition-public-health).

Food isn’t just a source of energy. It’s medicine that can be just as effective as certain drugs in healing diseases and illnesses. However, [toxic chemicals](https://www.wanttoknow.info/toxic-chemicalsnewsstories) in our food are linked to [devastating chronic diseases](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-reducing-pesticides-food-major-food-manufacturers-earn-f-grade), [irreversible consequences for children’s health](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2018/oct/24/entire-pesticide-class-should-be-banned-for-effect-on-childrens-health), and [major environmental destruction](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/us-pesticide-regulation-is-failing-the-hardest-hit-communities-its-time-to-fix-it/). Meanwhile, [billions of pounds of pesticides](https://www.levernews.com/toxic-harvest/) are used each year on our food despite their use being identified as a [cancer risk comparable to smoking](https://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/4792919-pesticides-cancer-link-study/).

**The organic food movement is a [game-changing remedy](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-health-benefits-organic-food-farming-outlined-new-report) to start addressing our health crisis.** Studies show that toxic pesticide levels [dropped by 60%](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-study-shows-toxic-pesticide-levels-families-dropped-60-after-oneweek-organic-diet) after eating an organic diet for just one week. Organic food is also linked to [significantly lower cancer risk](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-you-can-cut-your-cancer-risk-eating-organic-new-study-says) and is effective in [treating](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-balinese-foundation-treats-autistic-children-with-organic-food) and [reducing the severity](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a--miracle-cured-my-sons-autism-was-our-kitchen) of autism in children.

The [planetary health diet](https://eatforum.org/eat-lancet-commission/the-planetary-health-diet-and-you/) is a growing movement centered around foods rich in plants, focusing on sustainable eating practices that promote both human health and the health of our planet. Studies show that this “diet” can [significantly reduce chances](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-planetary-health-diet-cuts-early-death-risk-new-study-shows) of dying from premature deaths, cancer, cardiovascular diseases, lung disease, Alzheimer’s disease, and other neurodegenerative disorders.

**[German hospitals are now serving the planetary health diet](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-german-hospitals-serve-planetary-health-diet), where patients praise the meals and even become inspired to cook more vegetables at home. In a historic moment in Denmark, the Danish government [launched the world’s first national action plan](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-denmarks-radical-plan-a-plantbased-future) to promote plant-based diets.**

### **Other Inspiring Health News**

> *The world is good because it gives us all we need to create from it and with it. And, abiding in gratitude for that gift, we naturally desire to give in turn. We naturally desire to add our own creativity to creation, to make the world even more good, more alive, and more beautiful. And when I know that the world is good, I am not afraid.*
> – Charles Eisenstein

For seven consecutive years, Finland has been named the happiest country in the world. Not surprisingly, [Finland has one of the most robust welfare systems in the world](https://www.wanttoknow.info/a-finland-the-worlds-happiest-country-but-finns-say-were-confusing-happiness-something-else). In 2021, this Nordic nation invested 24% of its gross domestic product in [social protection](https://stm.fi/en/income-security/benefits), the highest among all OECD countries that year. Healthcare and education are free for all residents, extending up to the Ph.D. level.
